description: EC2 management, read-write access to the application-files S3 bucket, and read-only access to CloudWatch Logs.
notes: S3 access is scoped to a single named bucket (application files only), not the broader AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess managed policy, since S3 also stores user data that Developers should not access.
CloudWatch Logs access is read-only, matching the brief's 'logs viewing' requirement — not the CloudWatch or CloudWatch Events namespaces, which are separate permission surfaces.
See project documentation section 4.2 for the tag-conditioned dev/prod variant and the self-service instance-creation enhancement (aws:RequestTag) that extends this baseline.
